$comment: Which invocations the Node launcher hands to the native binary (`launcher`: native or node) and what the binary then does with them (`binary`: native answers itself, node delegates). Read by __tests__/native/routing-fixture.test.ts and native/cli/tests/routing.rs; a case without `binary` is checked against the launcher only; `platform` defaults to linux, `interactive` means stdout is a terminal, `files` are written into the project the binary runs in, `directory` runs it in a directory below the project root, and `stubPackageManagers` puts a `pnpm`, `npm`, `yarn` and `bun` that succeed on PATH, so a command that runs the package manager natively answers instead of handing over to Node.
